scope.edit: ReplicatedStorage.UI subtree plus business ScreenGui, SurfaceGui, BillboardGui and ProximityPrompt roots across the Edit DataModel; excludes platform CoreGui and Studio plugin GUI
scope.runtime: Selected Play client snapshots covering PlayerGui descendants that can function as UI, plus client-local Workspace prompts. Preview mesh parts are model data, not additional UI templates.
scope.assetChecks: Current RBXM exports were decoded locally and compared by relative path and class, with no import or deployment.
scope.sourceComparison: Relative source path, UTF-8 byte length and Adler-32 after CRLF normalization and trailing LF removal; compared to Edit buffer captured during this audit.
scope.persistentData: Live test used a VM-local in-memory SafeUpdate replacement installed at zero players, before adding a simulated negative-ID player. Main Edit instances were queried read-only.

format.path: Engine GetFullName, with the player prefix normalized to PlayerGui in runtime samples
format.occurrence: 1-based per matching runtime path because templates and clones can share a name
format.propertyScope: Readable reflection properties in Edit. Instance references are full paths, other compound engine values use tostring unless a format is listed. Omitted nil, Source and duplicate identity fields. Runtime snapshots capture display, geometry and connection-facing properties; effectiveVisibility checks Visible/Enabled ancestors only, not camera occlusion, clipping or actual pixel presence.
format.coordinateSpace: Edit AbsoluteSize is parent/context-dependent. Runtime Camera viewport and GetInsetArea(None) may differ. MCP export pixel dimensions are separate.
